const words = this.label.replace(/[-_]/g, ' ')
return words.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + words.slice(1)

folder = self.module_dir
return MarkdownScope(folder, self.domain_slug or folder.name, format=self.format or None)

current = self._current_fidelity
return current.format if current is not None else self._own_format

current = self._current_fidelity
return replace(super().markdown_scope, fidelity=current.name if current is not None else None)
return tuple(key for key in (self.extends, COMPANION_PRACTICE) if key and key != self.key)
return None if self._session_output is None else self._session_output.folder

examples = str(self.examples or "").strip()
templates = str(self.templates or "").strip()
scoped = self.scoped_markdown().strip()
if scoped:
    instructions(scoped)
if examples:
    instructions(examples)
if templates:
    instructions(templates)
# The practice's own Guidance section, then its current fidelity's guidance and companion text, which that
# fidelity answers.
current = self.fidelities.current
parts = [self.section_text("guidance").strip(), *(current.guidance_parts() if current is not None else ())]
return "\n\n".join(part for part in parts if part)

parent = getattr(self, "parent", None)
while parent is not None and not isinstance(parent, PracticeGuidance):
    parent = getattr(parent, "parent", None)
return parent

stored = getattr(self, "_clean_engineering", None)
if isinstance(stored, FidelityGuidance):
    return stored
practice = self.practice_guidance
companion = practice.companion if practice is not None else None
if not isinstance(stored, str) or not stored or companion is None:
    return None
self._clean_engineering = companion.fidelities[stored]
return self._clean_engineering

parent = self.practice_guidance.slug if self.practice_guidance is not None else Name(type(self).__name__).kebab
leaf = self._own_name.kebab
return f"{parent}-{leaf}" if leaf else parent

practice = self.practice_guidance
return practice.module_dir if practice is not None else super().module_dir

practice = self.practice_guidance
base = practice.install_folder if practice is not None else self.module_dir
leaf = (self.name or "").replace(" ", "-")
return base / leaf if leaf else base

practice = self.practice_guidance
return practice.document.fidelity_block(self.name) if practice is not None else ""

body = self.section
return f"### {self.name}\n\n{body}" if body else ""

located = self._template_markdown(self.format)
return located.location.path if located is not None else None
return [BoardFidelity(catalogued, shown) for catalogued in self.catalogued_practices.catalogued for shown in catalogued.shown_fidelities]
return [card for stage in self._stages for card in stage.cards]
return [fidelity for practice in self._board.practices for fidelity in practice.fidelities if self.requires(fidelity)]

columns = self._board.columns
following = columns[columns.index(self) + 1]
return following if isinstance(following, Stage) else None

columns = self._board.columns
earlier = columns[columns.index(self) - 1]
return earlier if isinstance(earlier, Stage) else None
return [ticket for ticket in self.cards if not ticket.is_done]
return [ticket for ticket in self.cards if ticket.is_done]

catalogued = self._catalogued
return f"{FORGE}/{catalogued.fidelity_href(self._fidelity) if self._has_page else catalogued.href}"
return self._stage.scope if self._stage is not None else None
return self._stage.actions if self._stage is not None else []
return self._stage.work_required if self._stage is not None else []
return list(self._stage.cards) if self._stage is not None else []

own = self._session.title or self._session.name
parent = self.parent if self.is_pulled_out else None
return f"{parent.title}.{own}" if parent is not None else own

named = self._session.parent
return self._board.ticket(named) if named else None

parent = self.parent
return [parent, *parent.ancestors] if parent is not None else []

if self.is_pulled_out or self.is_closed:
    return False
parent = self.parent
return parent is not None and not parent.is_closed
return not self.is_main and not self.is_closed and (bool(self.worktree) or self.is_active)

if self.is_main:
    return []
parent = self.parent
return [ticket.name for ticket in self._board.tickets if ticket is not parent and self._can_be_child_of(ticket)]

if self.is_main:
    return []
final = self._board.stages[-1]
closes = self.is_open or (not self.is_closed and self.column is final and self.is_done)
return [BACKLOG_COLUMN, *([COMPLETE_COLUMN] if closes else [])]

upcoming = self.next_fidelity
steps = self._board.stages[0].steps
following = f"Its next guidance is {upcoming.fidelity.slug}. " if upcoming else "Its stage is done and waits for a person to move it. "
return (
    f'CDD session board: you are working on ticket {self.name} ("{self.title}"), in {self.column.name}. '
    f"{following}Each fidelity goes through {', '.join(steps[:-1])}, then {steps[-1]}, and is done once its latest {steps[-1]} passes."
)

entries = self._session.log.entries
return entries[-1].time if entries else ""

if self._read is None:
    entries = self._ticket.session.log.entries
    self._read = [FidelityProgress.from_log(fidelity, stage, entries, self._ticket) for stage, fidelity in self._required]
return self._read

progress = self.progress
if self._enabled is None or self._enabled[0] is not progress:
    self._enabled = (progress, [entry for entry in progress if entry.is_enabled])
return self._enabled[1]
return self._practice.editor if self._fidelity is next(iter(self._practice.fidelities), None) else None
return [action for action in self._stage.steps if action not in self._done_actions]

remaining = self.remaining_actions
return remaining[0] if remaining else ""
return {action: self.command(action) for action in self._stage.actions}

has_output = bool(self._done_actions) or self._has_files
return [action for action in self._stage.actions if has_output or action not in ONCE_THERE_IS_OUTPUT]

latest = self.latest_report
return self._ticket.session.from_project(latest.file) if latest else ""
return any(progress.has_violations for progress in self._progress)
return sum(progress.violation_count for progress in self._progress)

fidelities = [progress.fidelity for progress in self._progress]
return {action: self._ticket.work.command(action, fidelities) for action in self._stage.actions}

if not self._progress:
    return []
first, *others = self._progress
return [action for action in first.allowed_actions if all(action in other.allowed_actions for other in others)]
return self.session_path is not None and self.session_path.parent.name == COMPLETE_FOLDER

with self._parts_lock:
    working = frozenset(key for key, output in self._own_outputs.items() if output.enabled)
    if self._graph is None or working != self._graph_practices:
        # Only the practices the session works on: a practice turned off for it is never read into its graph.
        graph = Graph(self._own_outputs[key].guidance for key in self._own_outputs if key in working)
        self._graph_practices = working
        # A session uses a graph created for it and saved in its own folder; a graph saved anywhere else, such
        # as the graph tool's, is not the session's.
        graph.kept_in = self.session_path
        graph.open_saved(self.work_root)
        if self.overlays:
            graph.overlays = self.overlays
        self._graph = graph
    return self._graph
return self._session_json.read() if self._session_json is not None else {}

outputs = self._own_outputs
return {key: outputs[key] for key in self.graph.practices.held}

latest = self.handoffs.latest
return self.from_project(latest) if latest is not None else ""
